annotation.summary_en: A young boy asks his parents where he came from, receiving two very different allegorical versions involving a goat and a noble deer.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a domestic living room setting. A young boy sits on a sofa next to his father, who wears a mustache and glasses. The boy asks how he came into this world. The father explains that in the forest, a beautiful goat was jumping around when suddenly another goat appeared, and that is how the boy was born. A television in the background displays old footage of a baby and a family photo, supporting the domestic theme. The scene then cuts to a woman sitting at a vanity table applying makeup. The boy approaches her and asks the same question. The woman, played by an actress, provides a more romanticized version, claiming a noble deer encountered the beautiful goat in the forest. When the boy mentions that his father called the animal a goat, the mother delivers the punchline, asserting that it was indeed a noble deer, but that his father was a goat and remained a goat. The sketch uses the double meaning of the word 'goat' in Armenian culture as both a literal animal and a disparaging term.
